answer: An operator funding fifty fakes hits the trap at the jetty, where every identity must declare its funding source, and identities sharing a source form one cluster whose bonds are slashed together. The first bond locks 100 tokens, and each new member adds 50 tokens to every bond, so ten fakes lock 5,500 tokens and fifty lock 127,500, with one proven fake wiping the lot. A cipher receipt links each bond to its cluster, etched in a shale ledger no operator can rewrite. An honest agent sails alone, risking only 100 tokens, like a single boat that never shares its hull with a sinking fleet.
